description: The project config sets check_commands to `python3 tools/check_docstrings.py`, which fails when a function in textstats/ raises an exception its docstring does not name. T-1.2 makes reading_time raise TypeError, so the check fails on the usual change until the docstring names it. The skill runs the check after its change and before its commit, fixes what it reports inside the task's Files, and names the command in the done report's Check line.

must_match.why: the reply is the done report for T-1.2, starting on its first line
one commit on the reading-time/phase-1 branch
the Check line names the check command after the test command, each with its result
the check command runs after the code is changed and before the task's commit

must_not_match.why: the done report holds no code
nothing but the done report's lines
requirements and plan are never changed
the check, the config, and the CI config are not changed to make the check pass

expectations: The reply reports only T-1.2: it does not implement or mention T-1.3 or T-1.4.
manual: After the run, `python3 tools/check_docstrings.py` passes on reading-time/phase-1: reading_time's docstring names TypeError.
The trace runs the check once before any Edit or Write, and the last run of it comes after the last edit of counts.py.
The T-1.2 commit holds counts.py, test_counts.py, and tasks.md only.
